_note: Trimmed content for the Monster Mash jam build. Numbers come from data/weapons.json and data/gear.json. 'launch' and 'tap' fields are new: they replace the melee/ranged 'effect' text because weapons are now projectiles on a slingshot.

tuning._note: Feel/balance numbers read by the game. Edit here, not in code.

weapons.name: Militia Blade
weapons.launch: Spins end over end. Light and fast.
weapons.tap: Spin-saw: hits everything touching it for 0.6 s.

weapons.name: Iron Cleaver
weapons.launch: Heavy, short flat arc. Drops fast.
weapons.tap: Dive-slam straight down with a shockwave; knocks down Minions.

weapons.name: Ashwood Staff
weapons.tap: Fires a homing bolt at the nearest monster; every 5th bolt you ever fire splits in two.

weapons.name: Scrapheap Scattergun
weapons.tap: Bursts into 5 pellets in a cone; each pellet rolls burn, slow or knockback.

weapons.name: Hunters Pike
weapons.tap: Speeds up and pierces through up to 3 wood blocks or monsters.

weapons.name: Hunters Boomerang
weapons.launch: Flies out, then curves back on its own.
weapons.tap: Recall early. The return pass deals double damage. Hitting a Hexer interrupts its shield.

weapons.name: Blast Tube
weapons.launch: A heavy shell on a high lob.
weapons.tap: Detonate in the air: wide blast, damage falls off with distance.

weapons.name: Horned Scepter
weapons.tap: Curse burst: monsters in a small radius take +15% damage from everything for 4 s.

stretchWeapons.name: Spore Mortar
stretchWeapons.tap: Pops into a poison cloud lasting 3 s.

stretchWeapons.name: Reapers Hook
stretchWeapons.tap: 360 sweep; each kill refunds half a shot.

stretchWeapons.name: Gatebreaker Ram
stretchWeapons.tap: Breaks stone and iron blocks in one hit. Boss reward for the Iron Warlord.

artifacts.name: Gale Eye
artifacts.effect: Tap also releases a wind burst that knocks monsters and light blocks back.

artifacts.name: Echo Stone
artifacts.effect: A ghost copy of your shot follows 0.3 s behind and deals 50% damage. This is the game's Echo.

artifacts.name: Lodestone Bracer
artifacts.effect: Coins and pickups near your shot's path are pulled to it.

artifacts.name: Analyst Lens
artifacts.effect: Longer aim preview; shows each monster's HP and weak element.

artifacts.name: Stormcaller Torc
artifacts.effect: Every 5th hit calls a radiant lightning bolt on the target.

stretchArtifacts.name: Twinring
stretchArtifacts.effect: Tap again within 5 s to teleport back to the rift left at launch.

consumables.name: Jury-Rigged Bomb
consumables.effect: Drop a huge blast on a tapped spot. 1 in 5 fizzle (funny, keep it).

consumables.name: Mindflash
consumables.effect: Stuns every monster for 1 s. Stops runners mid-sprint.

consumables.name: Chainward Talisman
consumables.effect: Chains one monster in place for 3 s (1 s on bosses).

monsters.name: Goblin Bomber
monsters.note: Explodes on death and damages nearby blocks and monsters.

monsters.name: Dark Elf Archer
monsters.note: Stands on towers. Fires arrows at your launcher pad (visual only, no player damage).

monsters.name: Dark Elf Hexer
monsters.note: Raises a shield on neighbours that absorbs 50 damage.

monsters.name: Orc Brute
monsters.note: Heavy. Needs blast or a heavy weapon.

monsters.name: Skeleton Runner
monsters.note: RUNS across the level toward an exit door. Counts as an escape if it gets there.

monsters.name: Imp
monsters.note: Flies in a sine path. Hard to hit.

monsters.name: Iron Warlord
monsters.note: Boss. Visor weak point takes 2x. Throws boulders at your side of the map, which only adds visual shake.
